tasks.title: Centralize legacy tool card parsing
tasks.description: Refactor the legacy session tool card so label extraction, argument badges, display type selection, and patch/file-change parsing come from the shared transcript utility and registry path. Preserve the existing ToolCallCard presentation, compact mode, raw input/output disclosure, terminal output, and file-change summary behavior while removing local duplicate parsing functions.
acceptanceCriteria: ToolCallCard no longer defines local copies of parseJsonSafely, getToolLabel, getToolArgs, TOOL_DISPLAY_TYPE, or parsePatchOperations
ToolCallCard uses shared helpers from transcript-tool-utils or registry-facing helpers for label, args, display type, and patch/file-change parsing
Known tools including bash, read, grep, glob, webfetch, task, skill, apply_patch, edit, and write still render with the same high-level semantic card type as before
Unknown tools still render a useful fallback title, labels or badges when available, and expandable raw input/output
tasks.notes: Keep this scoped to parsing ownership; do not redesign transcript layout or remove ToolCallCard unless it remains behavior-compatible.

tasks.title: Verify shared tool semantics
tasks.description: Add or update focused frontend regression coverage proving the legacy session view and registry/shared utility path agree on representative tool semantics. Cover labels, badges, display types, and patch/file-change parsing without relying on brittle styling snapshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression coverage verifies representative shared helper outcomes for summary, terminal, diff, and unknown tool cases
File-changing tools use shared patch/edit parsing for changed-file summaries
A future change to transcript-tool-utils for a covered tool would affect both the registry path and ToolCallCard behavior
tasks.output: packages/cli/web/tests/session-transcript-display.test.ts or related frontend transcript test file
tasks.notes: Use existing transcript tests where possible; run npm --prefix packages/cli/web run test:run for targeted tests and npm --prefix packages/cli/web run build for final verification.
